bayts.text: By the sanctity of the alif in the formula of refuge, make protection everlasting for me, O my Refuge.
By the sanctity of the ʿayn, pass over for ever (the faults) of whoever seeks shelter with me, wherever he worships.
By the sanctity of the wāw, direct toward me what I have sought from You, out of generosity, rightly aimed.
By the sanctity of the dhāl, abase whoever, among the children of time, is grieved by my joy.
By the bāʾ and the two lāms, grant me blessing, and make smooth for me, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), a (spiritual) legacy.
And grant me, by the hāʾ, the most beneficial gifts, and make lasting for me the best steadfastness and firmness.
And prevent, by the right of the mīm, whoever is accursed from heading toward me; and be for me and help me.
And drive away, by the right of the nūn, whoever has rebelled, toward what does not harm me, wherever he appears.
And send away every rebellious satan, by the alif of "shayṭān": let him not aim toward me.
And make others than me meet the Accursed when he seeks to harm, and do not let him attain his aim from me.
And with wretchedness drive Satan to lands other than those I possess.
May the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ) drive him off, making him despair of me, and may he not head toward me with plot or word.
By its ṭāʾ, turn his prowling toward directions other than mine, O Preserver, by that "toward" (elsewhere).
By the alif of "shayṭān", send his cunning to his own party, O You Whose remembrance I keep up.
By its nūn, thrust back into his throat all the plots he has amassed, and be for me, O All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ).
By the alif of "ar-rajīm", send back to him the harm he brought, and remove evil.
By its lām, turn blame upon him, spare me from him and make (the truth) known to my heart.
By its rāʾ, throw back upon him the harm he intended for me, when he lay in wait.
By its jīm, decree firmly that he turn for ever (away), toward what is hostile to me and toward whoever has not worshipped.
By its yāʾ, may the One, the Subduer (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), Giver of good, drive him toward others than me.
By its mīm, his Subduer has erased his heading toward me, and leads to me what I ask.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
Bless and grant peace for ever upon the Prophet, master of every kinsman and every stranger,
our master Muḥammad, and send blessing, O One Who has no partner in dominion.
And turn Satan and the plots toward a direction other than mine; lead no schemer to me.
And spare me corruption and envy, and lead to me no one corrupt or corrupting.
And be for me always in movements and stillnesses, and make my life most praiseworthy.
And make the Accursed despair of my precinct, O You to Whom goes my gratitude, abundant.
And shield me from what grieves me through "I seek refuge in Allah", and be for me a Bringer of glad tidings through the basmala.
And grant me, by the bāʾ, the finest permanence, a wonder to every man of worth who went before (me).
And grant me, by the sīn, a secret that is immense, O You Who free from need of whoever has grown proud.
And grant me, by the mīm, the erasing of what has issued from me, of what leads to turbidity.
And grant me, O Lord, the generosity of the One, by the alif of "Allāh", the Generous, the Refuge.
And grant me, by the two lāms, two kindnesses from You, both beautiful and pure.
And grant me, by the hāʾ, the awe of the Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), O You: toward what You are not pleased with for me I do not incline.
By the alif of "ar-Raḥmān", grant me the answering of prayer, O Originator (Al-Badīʿ) Who has bestowed nobility.
And grant me, by its lām, a tongue of truth (Qurʾān 26:84), and lead fair things to me always.
And grant me, by the rāʾ, a good pleasure that lasts, without wrath or toil, O Eternal (Al-Qadīm).
And grant me, by the ḥāʾ, an excellent safekeeping, O You to Whose door I have come imploring.
And grant me, by the mīm, an immediate possession, without reckoning, then a dominion to come.
And extend to me, by the alif, what is sought, O One; make hearts pliant for me.
And grant me, by the nūn, a light that blazes, and from You a benefit, with good pleasure, that is never cut off.
And grant me, by the alif of "ar-Raḥīm", the honour of the loving and of close kin.
And grant me a tongue of remembrance and good pleasure, by the lām and the rāʾ, and lead the goal to me.
And grant me, by its ḥāʾ, a gift of the Enricher, Who grants election to whom He wills.
And grant me, by its yāʾ, ease without hardship, and reward all of me with thanks and accept me.
And grant me, by its mīm, the erasing of all faults, folded wholly away, and knowledge of hidden things.
